cloud.failure_mode: Firmware/database downloads, fresh vendor-app services and remote cloud paths are unavailable. Local TRBT BLE status traffic does not require them.
cloud.notes: The legacy app also contained telemetry and SMS/USSD paths; no vendor credential is reproduced and neither is needed for local status reads.

methods.notes: Candidate only: confirm the write/notify layout and TRBT responses; do not assume every Nordic UART device is a Truma box.

identification.notes: No dependable advertised-name prefix was established. Match the Nordic UART service only as a candidate and confirm the TRBT dialect read-only; the same service is widely reused by unrelated serial modules.

device.name: Truma iNet Box (legacy)
device.notes:
Legacy Bluetooth-to-vehicle interface using ASCII TRBT: frames over a Nordic UART BLE link. The local protocol can outlive the legacy app/cloud. identify_only remains until a consumer implements the ASCII message transport and validates it without actuating vehicle systems.
DO NOT MIX PROTOCOLS: iNet X / iNet X Pro uses framed CBOR on the fc314000-… service, specified separately in truma-inet-x.yaml. Never send these TRBT frames to iNet X or CBOR to this legacy box.
The app also has a phone-as-peripheral mode and older BT hardware UUIDs; they are not evidence that every box exposes the same layout. The confirmed source-derived client path here is Nordic UART 6e400001-… with 6e400002-… write and 6e400003-… notify. The standalone LevelControl ultrasonic sensor is a separate follow-up, not silently included in this box profile.
SCOPE: status reads are described. Heating/cooling controls, switches, configuration, pairing changes, SMS/USSD and firmware are not offered as ordinary commands. Message IDs are a vocabulary, not permission to send every message to a vehicle.

exclusivity.recovery: Close the legacy app/other central and retry without changing pairing state; hardware behavior is unverified.

pairing.notes: Static analysis alone does not establish whether a bond is required, optional or absent.

unpair.notes: The protocol has pair/unpair message IDs, but no safe hardware-verified procedure is established.

credentials.notes: No application credential requirement is established for local status reads.

factory_reset.effect: No factory-reset or bond-clear procedure is established. Message IDs for pairing/unpairing are not a safe substitute for a documented reset.

methods.basis: Legacy app protocol analysis; no box was connected by this project.
methods.description: Connect, subscribe to 6e400003-… and use only a documented status request after confirming the family. Do not run configuration, pairing, switch or firmware messages during identification.
methods.name: Read-only Nordic UART confirmation

steps.action: Connect and confirm 6e400002-… write plus 6e400003-… notify.
Subscribe to notifications and, only after family confirmation, issue the documented vehicle-status request.
steps.expect: A TRBT response with message ID 0017 and response flag 0004; stop on another dialect.

setup.notes: No Wi-Fi provisioning is involved. The app's local connection flow was recovered statically, but link-layer bonding and first-run requirements were not established on hardware.

rejoin.notes: There is no Wi-Fi network to rejoin. Close the old central and reconnect; whether a persisted bond is required remains unknown, so do not clear owner pairing state as a first-line remedy.

testing.notes: No box, vehicle, LIN bus or firmware operation was exercised by this project. Protocol facts derive from the legacy app's readable JavaScript and public manuals. The retired inet.truma.com cloud was checked on 2026-09-01 and did not resolve/respond; the local BLE protocol is independent of that cloud, but no live replay was performed.

dfu_mode.notes: No separate update-mode identity or recovery advertisement is established.

enter.notes: The running box accepts START/DATA/END; no safe entry or bootloader probe is declared.

local_access.summary: The stock box exchanges ASCII TRBT messages locally over Nordic UART. Status and configuration messages share one transport; this spec exposes the read-side structure only.

VehicleStatus.description: ASCII payload for message 0x0017. Split on colon, preserve the trailing empty field, and parse each token as uppercase hexadecimal.

parse_rules: Check the complete message ID and flags before using this layout; expect ID 0017 and RESPONSE flag 0004 for the query.
Old format has indices 0..15 plus the trailing delimiter; new format adds ambient light at index 16.
For every numeric/switch field, low byte FD means invalid, FE no value, FF device unavailable; FB/FC are reserved. Do not scale a sentinel into a plausible reading.
Tank and ambient-light units remain unknown; keep those values raw.

flags.0x0001: REQUEST: empty request for MSGID with zero payload
flags.0x0002: MORE: additional messages of this type follow / array transfer

trbt.length: Four hex digits: payload byte count only, excluding the 20-byte header
trbt.payload: Colon-separated fixed-width hexadecimal fields with a trailing colon
trbt.query_note: The vehicle-status query uses a 62-byte zero-value 13-segment template with MORE (0002), not an empty REQUEST frame; the successful answer uses RESPONSE (0004).
trbt.reassembly: Append notifications; parse a header only with at least 20 bytes, wait for LEN payload bytes, then continue with the next message

remaining_unknowns: Advertised name, bonding, first-run behavior and live confirmation of the Nordic UART service and vehicle-status request.
Tank/ambient-light units, all remaining message layouts and safe read-only behavior across box/vehicle firmware generations.
Factory reset, standalone unpairing, firmware image/signature validation and interrupted-update recovery.
Standalone LevelControl protocol and older Bluetooth hardware generations; they are not covered by this Nordic UART profile.

query_vehicle_status.description: Source-derived vehicle-status request: 13-segment zero template with MORE flag; expect ID 0017 with RESPONSE flag 0004.

characteristics.name: TRBT Write
characteristics.notes: The header's LEN is the ASCII PAYLOAD byte count, excluding the 20-byte header. This request has a 62-byte payload and therefore LEN 003E. Do not compute LEN over the complete 82-byte frame.

characteristics.name: TRBT Notify
characteristics.notes: Responses and unsolicited status messages. Concatenate notifications before parsing; multiple messages can share one notification.
